reason: I lost an order last month just because someone else quoted first, and Rs 5,000 with a money-back condition is nothing for a firm our size. I'd do the pilot to prove to my father that quoting fast actually wins orders, but I'm only committing to the pilot, not the Rs 60,000 yet.
objection: IndiaMART already gives me a catalogue and enquiries, so the website part feels like paying twice, and our rates change daily and vary by customer and quantity, so I doubt a small outfit's system will draft prices my team doesn't have to fix. I also don't know what happens to my price list if they fold.
would_change_my_mind: If the pilot drafts come back wrong on prices more than a few times in the first week, I stop and take the refund. To go to full setup I'd need to talk to the chemical-trading reference and see it handle our quantity-slab pricing.
